Gochujang salmon bowls in 20 min 🍣

Sauce: 2 tbsp gochujang, 1 tbsp soy sauce, 1 tbsp honey, 1 tsp sesame oil
Brush over 2 salmon fillets and air fry at 400F for 9 mins.
Serve over rice with cucumber, avocado, and sliced green onions. Sprinkle sesame seeds!

My grandma's banana bread!
INGREDIENTS
3 very ripe bananas
1/3 cup melted butter
3/4 cup sugar
1 egg, beaten
1 tsp vanilla
1 tsp baking soda
pinch of salt
1 1/2 cups all-purpose flour

Mash the bananas, mix in the butter. Add sugar, egg, vanilla. Sprinkle baking soda and salt over and mix. Add flour. Bake at 350F for 1 hour.
